failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query asks 'What is the genealogical lineage from Louis, Count of Armagnac (father of Charlotte de Lorraine-Armagnac) to Umberto II of Italy, and does this establish that Charlotte de Lorraine-Armagnac's father has Umberto II as a descendant?' However, hop 1 already retrieved the passage 'Louis of Lorraine... His descendants include Albert II, Prince of Monaco, Umberto II of Italy...' and hop 2 retrieved the exact same passage again. The hop 3 query requests the same genealogical information already provided in hops 1 and 2, returning duplicate documents including 'Louis, Count of Armagnac' passage three times total across all hops.

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states 'The claim cannot be verified from the provided passages' and lists as missing 'Identity of Princess Charlotte of Lorraine' and 'Identity of Princess Charlotte of Lorraine's father'. However, hop 1 already contained passage [1] 'Louis of Lorraine... His descendants include... Umberto II of Italy' which establishes Louis as having Umberto II as a descendant. Hop 2 retrieved passage [5] 'Charlotte de Lorraine-Armagnac... was a Princess of Lorraine by birth and daughter of Louis, Count of Armagnac' which directly identifies Princess Charlotte of Lorraine and her father. Summary_1 failed to recognize this evidence was present in hop 1 passages.
